name: micro-fe-prototype
description: Two micro frontend integration strategies (shared React singleton vs independent React versions) running side by side

scripts.start: node scripts/ports.mjs check all && pnpm build && pnpm serve
scripts.start:option1: node scripts/ports.mjs check option1 && pnpm build:option1 && pnpm serve:option1
scripts.start:option2: node scripts/ports.mjs check option2 && pnpm build:option2 && pnpm serve:option2
scripts.dev: node scripts/ports.mjs check all && concurrently -k -n compare,o1-shell,o1-app1,o1-app2,o2-shell,o2-app1,o2-app2 -c magenta,blue,cyan,cyan,yellow,green,green "pnpm --filter compare dev" "pnpm --filter @o1/shell dev" "pnpm --filter @o1/app1 dev" "pnpm --filter @o1/app2 dev" "pnpm --filter @o2/shell dev" "pnpm --filter @o2/app1 dev" "pnpm --filter @o2/app2 dev"
scripts.dev:option1: node scripts/ports.mjs check option1 && concurrently -k -n o1-shell,o1-app1,o1-app2 -c blue,cyan,cyan "pnpm --filter @o1/shell dev" "pnpm --filter @o1/app1 dev" "pnpm --filter @o1/app2 dev"
scripts.dev:option2: node scripts/ports.mjs check option2 && concurrently -k -n o2-shell,o2-app1,o2-app2 -c yellow,green,green "pnpm --filter @o2/shell dev" "pnpm --filter @o2/app1 dev" "pnpm --filter @o2/app2 dev"
scripts.serve: node scripts/ports.mjs check all --built && concurrently -k -n compare,o1-shell,o1-app1,o1-app2,o2-shell,o2-app1,o2-app2 -c magenta,blue,cyan,cyan,yellow,green,green "pnpm --filter compare dev" "pnpm --filter @o1/shell preview" "pnpm --filter @o1/app1 preview" "pnpm --filter @o1/app2 preview" "pnpm --filter @o2/shell preview" "pnpm --filter @o2/app1 preview" "pnpm --filter @o2/app2 preview"
scripts.serve:option1: node scripts/ports.mjs check option1 --built && concurrently -k -n o1-shell,o1-app1,o1-app2 -c blue,cyan,cyan "pnpm --filter @o1/shell preview" "pnpm --filter @o1/app1 preview" "pnpm --filter @o1/app2 preview"
scripts.serve:option2: node scripts/ports.mjs check option2 --built && concurrently -k -n o2-shell,o2-app1,o2-app2 -c yellow,green,green "pnpm --filter @o2/shell preview" "pnpm --filter @o2/app1 preview" "pnpm --filter @o2/app2 preview"
